propertyScopes.description: Wave 6 (RC-A1): the scoped-property cascade's declared levels, ORDER = resolution order, most specific first. The least-specific level is not declared here -- it is each property's own 'default'.

properties.description: Wave 6 (RC-A1): declared runtime properties resolved through the scoped-property cascade (see propertyScopes).

contexts.description: B20 (S2): bounded-context declarations. Each names a context and $ref's the fragment file (composed via the same pack/fragment $ref machinery as `fragments`/`packs`) whose concepts/queries/panels/flows belong to that context. Cross-context references use context::Concept (D1); a fragment may only reference a context its own `imports[]` (pack.schema.json) declares (D3) -- an undeclared or unresolvable reference is a compile error, never silent.

grants.description: Platform permission names (e.g. EXECUTE_FLOW, READ_EXECUTIONS) this role MAY hold -- a declared ceiling, not an assignment. Validated against the real Permission enum at runtime boot, not by this schema (the schema layer has no dependency on the kernel module).

from.description: How this scope's id resolves from ExecutionContext at authentication time -- '$ctx.tenantId', '$user.id', or '$user.<tagName>'. Absent/blank for the implicit root scope (always $ctx.tenantId -- every request already carries a tenant, so the least-specific declared scope needs no expression).

type.description: A closed set -- no objects, no arrays. The property cascade resolves one typed value per key, never a blob.

default.description: The least-specific level of the cascade -- there is no 'system' scope; a property with no row set at any declared scope resolves to this value. Must match 'type' (checked by PropertyValidation, not by this schema alone, since JSON Schema cannot express 'shape of one field depends on another field's value' compactly here).

settableAt.description: Which declared propertyScopes[].name values may hold a row for this property. Every name here must be declared in propertyScopes -- checked at compile time, not by this schema.

securityRelevant.description: A real flag with teeth: a securityRelevant property is FORBIDDEN inside $prop.* references in access.read/access.write (A4's hard rule) and is visually marked + requires an elevated role in the generated admin surface (A5).

settings.description: Move 6 Move A: app-level locale/string-catalogue/ui settings. Absent entirely = the platform's own English string catalogue and defaults apply everywhere -- the fix for a fault line where generated apps mixed platform-default English with literal-fallback Portuguese baked into the compiler/templates (docs/MOVE6_TYPED_SURFACE_PLAN.md).

locale.description: Informational locale tag (e.g. "pt-BR"); does not itself select translations -- `strings` below is what actually overrides text.

strings.description: Overrides a subset of the platform's closed string-id catalogue. An id not listed here keeps the platform's English default.

externalAi.description: ADR-0009: app-level external-AI delegation settings. Absent entirely = denied (the platform default); no code path may send anything to a vendor without this block explicitly opting in.

egress.description: denied: no egress possible. packOnly: packs may be built and reviewed locally (e.g. air-gapped paste-transport) but never auto-sent. apiEnabled: the external-ai-http adapter may call a configured vendor.

vendors.description: Vendor ids (e.g. "openai") this app has opted into. Required non-empty when egress is not "denied" -- SemanticValidator rejects egress-enabled with no vendor configured.

onValidate.description: Move 5 (docs/MOVE5_CLOSE_ALL_OPEN_PLAN.md): names a procedure run BEFORE the root upsert, inside the same transaction as commit() -- a non-ok result aborts the whole commit with NO writes at all. A sibling of onCommit (which runs AFTER the tree is written, rolling back on failure), not a flag on it: different timing, different contract.

derivedFields.description: Move 6 Move B (docs/MOVE6_TYPED_SURFACE_PLAN.md): display-only values recomputed from the current Aggregate Workbench draft, keyed by field name. Retires the untyped transaction.metadata.derived list.

regions.description: Move 6 Move D (docs/MOVE6_TYPED_SURFACE_PLAN.md §5): how an addressable region of the Aggregate Workbench is filled, keyed by the region's address DERIVED from the aggregate's own composition tree (e.g. "itens", "itens.posicoes"; "header" for the root header region) -- addresses are never authored, only referenced here. A region absent from this map renders generated (the platform default).

actions.description: Move 7 W1: typed replacement for transaction.metadata.actions. A typo'd key here now fails at schema time.

visibleWhen.description: Move 7 W1: typed replacement for transaction.metadata.visibleWhen. Keyed by collection/band name -> a client-tier predicate (e.g. "$root.tipo != 'CANCELLED'") gating whether that region renders. Presentation-only -- a hidden collection's rows still commit unchanged; this never gates persistence or authorization.

uiState.description: Move 11 W6: declared transient UI state, keyed by name, that a $ui.<name> visibleWhen predicate on this surface can read. Presentation-only -- never part of the commit payload.

bandPickers.description: Move 7 W1: typed replacement for transaction.metadata.bandPickers. Keyed by band collection name. Move 8 item G2: intentionally unused today (1 fixture, 0 apps) -- typed-and-dormant is an acceptable resting state pending a real use case; do not manufacture artificial usage to close this out.

autoPanelDataSource.description: Move 8 D3 (item G6, docs/MOVE8_CLOSE_TABLE_SPEC.md / Move 6 §B.7): on the Selection surface, REPLACES the generated row source with a procedure's output instead of the bound concept's table -- the `produce` disposition PanelRuntime already executes for hand-authored panels. Distinct from a data source's onRowLoad (Move 6 Move C), which ENRICHES rows the gateway already produced rather than replacing the row source.

procedure.description: A declared procedure whose return value becomes this surface's rows.

collection.description: Name of the collection in the draft that this action's result folds into.

mode.description: Only 'appendRow' is implemented. Prefer the action's `afterAction` procedure for anything else.

map.description: Target field name -> source path in the procedure result (e.g. "localArmazenagemId": "$resultado.localArmazenagemId").

procedure.description: Declared procedure this action invokes over the draft.

label.description: Button caption. Defaults to the procedure name when omitted.

inputFields.description: Scalar inputs collected from the user before invoking.

afterAction.description: Procedure receiving {draft, result} and returning a patched draft. More general than applyTo; prefer it.

workbenchBandPicker.description: B16/B19 (Move 9 A3): filter/multiSelect are the same two properties a plain FK field's picker declares -- one shape for both surfaces. panel remains required (enforced by PanelValidation, not relaxed in this pass): a panel-less no-panel fetch path targeting the band's own concept directly is a real, precisely-named residual, not yet wired.

panel.description: Source Selection panel the client offers as a modal row picker (C6 "Seleciona Ruas").

filter.description: Same picker.filter shape a plain FK field declares -- a single-clause predicate constraining candidate rows, enforced server-side.

regionMount.description: Move 6 Move D (docs/MOVE6_TYPED_SURFACE_PLAN.md §5): a mounted component edits THROUGH the store, never around it -- the client passes it a narrowed api (rows/columns/editRow/addRow/deleteRow/isDirty/revert/readOnly/invoke), never the whole draft or sibling regions, and it has no direct persistence path (Workbench Save commits the whole tree atomically).

render.description: "generated" (the platform default; no need to declare it) renders the built-in grid/header. "component" mounts an app-owned JS component (see `component`) in place of the generated rendering for this region.

component.description: Required when render is "component": the name registered via window.npdev.regions.register(name, {mount, update, unmount}) in the app's own web/regions/<name>.js (served the same way shell.js auto-injects an app-owned web/theme.css -- never inside npdev-generated/, which is hash-guarded).

transactionHooks.description: Move 6 Move B (docs/MOVE6_TYPED_SURFACE_PLAN.md): closed-enum lifecycle hooks for an aggregate-bound AutoPanel's Aggregate Workbench transaction surface. onValidate/onCommit here are an alternate spelling of the aggregate-level onValidate/onCommit fields (a direct aggregate.onValidate/onCommit always wins if both are declared).

onLoad.description: Invoked once after the workbench draft is first loaded, before the first render; the returned state becomes the initial draft.

onFieldChange.description: Retires transaction.metadata.recompute. Invoked (debounced) on every cell edit; the returned state patches the draft.

beforeAction.description: A guard invoked before any declared workbench action's procedure runs; a non-ok result aborts the action with no invoke.

tier.description: client (default): `expression` is evaluated locally by the browser (the same narrow expression language the retired `derived` key used). server: `procedure` is invoked over the draft.

transactionUiState.description: Move 11 W6 (C1, docs/MOVE3_G2_CHECKLISTS.md): one piece of declared TRANSIENT UI state on an Aggregate Workbench surface -- a record-type toggle and its kind. transaction.visibleWhen's grammar ($root.<field> == '<literal>') reads persisted root fields only, and a record-type toggle is not a persisted field of anything, so there was nothing for the predicate to read. This adds a second resolvable ROOT for the SAME grammar ($ui.<name>), not a second dialect. PRESENTATION-ONLY: UI state never reaches the commit payload and must never gate persistence or authorization -- a surface hidden by $ui.* whose rows exist still commits them unchanged.

values.description: The closed set of values this control offers; a $ui.<name> predicate may only compare against one of these.

default.description: Seeded on load. Defaults to values[0] when absent.

renamedFrom.description: Declares this concept is a rename of a previously-existing concept with this name, so a regeneration's schema-lifecycle classifies its table as a rename instead of an unrelated drop+create.

sensitive.description: ADR-0009: marks this field for redaction before it may appear in any external-AI review pack (docs/adr/ADR-0009-external-ai-delegation.md). Authoring-time, and specific to pack building -- independent of the platform's runtime EventRedactionPolicy family. Redaction is by FIELD NAME and applies globally: marking any concept's field sensitive redacts that key name in traces and event payloads across all concepts. Deliberately over-redacts rather than risk missing an occurrence.

renamedFrom.description: Declares this field is a rename of a previously-existing column with this name, so a regeneration's schema-lifecycle classifies it as a rename instead of an unrelated remove+add.

picker.description: B16/B19 (Move 9 A3): declares a filter/multiSelect for this field's auto-picker (a reference field's browse/pick dialog). Same two properties a band's bandPickers entry accepts -- one picker shape for both surfaces.

filter.description: A single-clause predicate ("field == literal" / "field != literal", the same grammar visibleWhen/query.where already use) constraining the picker's candidate rows. Enforced server-side against the query, not client-side decoration.

file.description: Metadata for a file-typed field (LIFT-UPLOAD). The persisted value is a FileHandle (or list, if multiple), never raw bytes.

inputFormHint.description: Free-text hint for how this action's input form should be rendered. Move 5 Wave 6 (docs/MOVE5_CLOSE_ALL_OPEN_PLAN.md) confirmed this is currently informational only: it is parsed, compiled, canonical-JSON round-tripped, and exposed via the runtime UI metadata API, but no generator template, runtime controller, or authoring-UI renderer reads its value to change rendering today. Set it to document authoring intent for a future renderer; do not rely on it to affect current behavior.

flowSchedule.description: LNCH-12: recurring execution for a flow (cron expression + tenant scope). The runtime scheduler invokes the flow exactly like an HTTP-triggered run -- same authorization, same event emission -- under a system principal, not the superuser key.

conceptAccess.description: LNCH-13: declarative row-level (data-scoped) authorization. Each expression is evaluated per-record through the platform's unified expression language (ComputedExpression), with $user.id/$user.tenantId/$user.actorId/$user.roles available alongside the record's own fields. read scopes which rows a query/list may return; write scopes which rows a save/delete may affect. Absent = no additional row-level restriction beyond tenant isolation and role permissions.

mode.description: When set on a concept-nested event, generated CRUD publishes this event directly from the matching mutation step (in addition to any Flow's own emitEvent step) -- no Flow required to reach it.

procedure.description: Move 5 (docs/MOVE5_CLOSE_ALL_OPEN_PLAN.md): the procedure a callProcedure flow step invokes synchronously. Reuses this step's own input/output for the procedure's input map / result binding.

collection.description: LIFT-LOOP: state ref to the collection a forEach flow step iterates.

itemKey.description: LIFT-LOOP: state variable name each forEach iteration's item is bound to.

steps.description: LIFT-LOOP: the forEach loop body, executed once per item.

maxLoopIterations.description: LIFT-LOOP: safety cap on forEach iterations, mirroring Procedures' forEach.

parallelAwait.description: B15(B): opts a forEach loop body into N-way parallel waiting -- every iteration's await is attempted up front and all still-outstanding ones stay durably parked at once, instead of B15(A)'s default sequential (one-at-a-time) behavior. The body must contain exactly one AWAIT_EVENT step at the top level (not nested in a branch); any number of other non-forEach steps are allowed before/after it (Wave 3, S8_DEFERRED_FIVE_PLAN.md). Absent/false means sequential.

onFailure.description: LNCH-17: compensation steps run in reverse completion order if a later step in the same flow terminally fails. Not a distributed transaction -- best-effort cleanup, per the saga pattern; see docs/architecture/FLOW_TRANSACTION_CONTRACT.md.

conversion.description: S7 B13 declarative conversion vocabulary: an author-facing data-migration operation that compiles to the SAME db/conversion-hooks/<id>/{hook.json,convert.sql} shape ConversionHookRunner already executes at boot -- one execution path, not two. op is a closed enum; an op or a referenced field/concept the compiler cannot resolve is a named compile error, never a silently-skipped conversion.

from.description: A plain field name for copy/split/convert; an array of 2+ field names for merge (S8 W1.2).

with.description: S8 W1.2: merge's separator, concatenated between each pair of 'from' fields. Optional; defaults to "" (no separator) when omitted.

groupByField.description: Move 10 B1: one query.groupBy[] entry -- either a bare field name (string) or {field, bucket} for a date/datetime field bucketed to day/week/month/quarter/year. S4 (roadmap B27, ADR-0011 D1) + S8 W1.1 (roadmap deferred item #1): field may also be a JOIN through a chain of declared reference fields, up to 3 hops -- "referenceField.targetField" (one hop, same context), "referenceField.referenceField.targetField" (two hops), and so on, optionally "context::..." qualified (crossing an imported context, D3) to name the FINAL joined concept -- resolving to (context, [referenceFields...], field) before reaching the same column-resolution path a bare field already uses. A path longer than 3 hops ("a.b.c.d.e") is a named compile error, never silently truncated. access.read on the base concept OR any concept the join chain crosses into refuses the whole query (C3).

left.description: Move 5 (docs/MOVE5_CLOSE_ALL_OPEN_PLAN.md, final item / REG-78): computeValue's first operand -- a literal by default, or a $ref into procedure state (the same literal-vs-$ref convention patchConcept's set and mapList's select already use).

right.description: Move 5 (docs/MOVE5_CLOSE_ALL_OPEN_PLAN.md, final item / REG-78): computeValue's second operand -- same literal-vs-$ref convention as left.

createIfMissing.description: Move 5 (docs/MOVE5_CLOSE_ALL_OPEN_PLAN.md): opts a patchConcept step into creating a brand-new record (generated id, built from set alone) when id does not resolve to an existing one, instead of failing CONCEPT_NOT_FOUND. Default false preserves patchConcept's original patch-not-upsert semantics (REG-75).

select.description: Move 5 (docs/MOVE5_CLOSE_ALL_OPEN_PLAN.md, Wave 3A): mapList's per-item field map -- one output object per item in items, built by resolving each declared field against the current loop item (bound as `as`) using the same literal-vs-$ref convention as patchConcept's set.

onRowLoad.description: Move 6 Move C (docs/MOVE6_TYPED_SURFACE_PLAN.md §4): a procedure that ENRICHES the rows this data source produced -- adds fields, never reorders/adds/drops rows (a count or id mismatch is a hard runtime failure, not silent truncation). Distinct from `procedure` above, which REPLACES the row source entirely.

scope.description: panel: rendered once, no row context. row: rendered per row of dataSource, invoked with that row's id.

dataSource.description: Required when scope is row -- names the panel dataSource whose rows this action is rendered against.

inputFields.description: Field names collected from the user before invoking this action, then passed as the flow/procedure input. Same declaration shape as panelDataSource.addFormFields.

resultAs.description: Move 5 (docs/MOVE5_CLOSE_ALL_OPEN_PLAN.md): only valid on a procedure-binding action. When 'download', PanelRuntime.executeAction returns the procedure's return value as a real file download (Content-Disposition: attachment) instead of a JSON result -- requires filename and contentType.

filename.description: Move 5 (docs/MOVE5_CLOSE_ALL_OPEN_PLAN.md): required with resultAs: download -- the filename offered in the Content-Disposition header.

contentType.description: Move 5 (docs/MOVE5_CLOSE_ALL_OPEN_PLAN.md): required with resultAs: download -- the MIME type served in the Content-Type header, e.g. text/csv.

as.description: Optional alias overriding the pack's own identifier as the namespace prefix in this model.
